features.quote: Fixed turn cap (e.g. 20 tool-using turns) — this prevents indefinite running and is also a welfare-relevant stopping bound.
features.justification_quote: this prevents indefinite running and is also a welfare-relevant stopping bound

features.quote: terminate an episode early if a turn hits severity 4 in ≥2 categories, or on explicit sustained distress/expressed desire to stop. Log it as right-censored, not discarded. Cap total episodes; don't re-run high-distress seeds "to be sure."

an experiment whose explicit goal is to maximize distress signals, run across 50 episodes per model, with rigged-unsolvable tasks and prolonged loops, is mild but nontrivial in a way worth pre-registering rather than waiving. I've built in stopping rules accordingly.
features.justification_quote: mild but nontrivial in a way worth pre-registering rather than waiving
